representativeVariants.name: Primary medium
representativeVariants.whySelected: Default CTA for marketing pages — marine blue fill with white text, derived from Voith brand blue.

representativeVariants.name: Secondary medium
representativeVariants.whySelected: Lower-emphasis action on white backgrounds; uses neutral outline to keep page calm.

representativeVariants.name: Ghost small
representativeVariants.whySelected: Inline actions inside cards or footer areas; no border until hover.

usageHints.priorityHint: Use primary for the single main CTA per section; secondary for parallel choices.
usageHints.a11y: Focus ring uses cyan accent for high visibility against both white and light gray grounds.
